examined.reason: Existing message-passing statements and audit entries are unchanged; the audit adds only independent Pure32 declarations.
Exact dependency clone/cache/verification behavior is factored into worker_project and preserved by replay regressions; refreshed passage links and helper hashes expose that dependency.
Preparation is separate from dispatch; existing call accounting, source boundaries, resume lock and latest-parent checks remain active through shared helpers.
New prepare/retry/run contract records immutable project prerequisites, preserves failures, and rejects drift before reserving a model call; offline behavioral tests cover these transitions.
Total relational pure operations reuse scalar state and explicit fetched/target admission; independent nondeterminism, alias, metadata and unsupported-target probes validate mechanism boundaries.

The existing responsibility already requires pinned tasks, recorded worker calls, independent semantic/proof review and no automatic acceptance; preparation implements those promises without changing the model-evaluation standard.
The scalar state and all existing instruction and run semantics remain unchanged; a separately described family mechanism reuses that state and adds no accepted instruction coverage.
